{{Tag info
| title = Negative Tag
| image = Negative tag.png
| description = Next base edition shop Joker is free and becomes [[Negative|{{hl|edition|Negative}}]]
| ante = 2+
| unlock = Discover the {{edition|Negative}} edition
}}
The '''Negative Tag''' is a [[Tag]] that can be acquired either by skipping a {{Blind|Small Blind}} or a {{Blind|Big Blind}}. This Tag starts to appear at [[Ante 2]].

Acquiring this Tag would make the next base edition [[Joker]], found in the [[Shop]], have a {{Edition|Negative}} edition instead. It would also cost {{money|0}} instead of its original cost.

==Notes==
<!-- transclude to Foil Tag, Holographic Tag, Polychrome Tag -->
* If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, this Tag will instead be stored.
* Works with the {{Tag|Uncommon}} and {{Tag|Rare}} if the generated Joker does not have an edition naturally.
* On {{Stake|Black}} and higher, the Joker affected by the {{FULLPAGENAME}} can have any in-run [[Sticker]] that is available for that Stake.
* The {{D|Jokerless}} [[challenge]] bans {{FULLPAGENAME}}.

==Strategy==
* While {{Edition|Negative}} Jokers can be very useful, in the case of this tag it will be applied to a random Joker from the Shop. There's no guarantee the Joker will be useful or even usable at all to a given build, and skipping a blind costs skipping the benefits and opportunities from playing a blind and visiting the subsequent shop. That said the Negative Joker will definitely bring the benefits any regular Negative brings, such as increasing {{Tarot|Temperance}}'s value and nullifying the {{Blind|Verdant Leaf}} Boss Blind.
** The latter benefit is less likely to take place on {{Stake|Black}} and higher, as the Joker made Negative by the tag can potentially appear with an {{Sticker|Eternal}}, and thus cannot be sold to disable the boss blind.
* Due to {{D|Anaglyph}}'s innate ability of generating {{Tag|Double}}s upon defeating a Boss Blind, it is possible to stack a substantial amount of them and collect a Negative Tag when it appears, thus transforming all the collected Double Tags into Negative Tags. The risk of a Negative Tag hitting a useless Joker may be reduced, but this is still very much a high risk strategy.
** A Negative Tag hitting a useless Joker may still be beneficial as owning it will prevent it from appearing it in the shop again, unless {{J|Showman}} is active.
** This is a commonly suggested strategy for players looking to obtain [[Completionist++]], however, the effectiveness of this strategy gradually reduces with the amount of {{Sticker|Gold|name=Gold Stickers}} owned, and the player will often win runs less, at the trade off of each win earning more Gold Stickers at once.
* If the player wishes to take the Negative Tag at any point, it's imperative that the current Joker build can accommodate for missing a Shop and the bigger Blind requirements, especially on higher stakes.

== Trivia ==
* The Negative Tag is the only edition-related Tag that cannot appear in Ante 1.
